classification.notes: This is a DTCC operational/product notice about DRS Withdrawal-by-Transfer processing and DRS Centralized Billing transitioning to SPA. It is an internal DTCC system migration announcement with no risk angle matching any card's Step 1 trigger (no market event, no member stress, no regulatory mandate affecting clearing volumes, no cyber/outage, no settlement cycle change). None of the 16 cards cover DTC transfer agent processing migrations of this type.
